description: Test cases for AssistantTextParser, validating its segmentation and visibility logic for assistant text with internal tags.

classes.name: AssistantTextParserTests
classes.description: Test suite for AssistantTextParser to verify segmentation behavior and visibility logic.

methods.name: splitsThinkAndFinalSegments
methods.description: Tests that input with <think> and <final> tags are correctly segmented into thinking and response parts.

methods.name: keepsTextWithoutTags
methods.description: Verifies that plain text without tags is treated as a single response segment.

methods.name: ignoresThinkingLikeTags
methods.description: Ensures tags similar to <thinking> but not exactly matching are ignored.

methods.name: dropsEmptyTaggedContent
methods.description: Checks that empty tags like <think></think> produce no segments.

methods.name: hidesThinkingSegmentsFromVisibleOutput
methods.description: Verifies that segments marked as thinking are hidden in visible output by default.

methods.name: thinkingOnlyTextIsNotVisibleByDefault
methods.description: Confirms that only <think> content is hidden unless explicitly included.
